text: Thomas, this is one of those songs that doesn’t speak of a feeling slowly growing... it speaks of that instant when something happens and we can no longer pretend we don’t feel it. There’s such a strong energy in that move from doubt to certainty, as if a single look were enough to change everything. And I especially love the idea of no longer hiding what has become impossible to hide... when the feeling finally finds the courage to be spoken. ❤❤ ❤
